content.text: Clause 12.3 expressly negates any exclusivity commitment by Customer, and 12.4 grants exclusivity-like protection in our favour.

input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer, meeting the preferred position. Clause 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer is free to engage any supplier and has made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment; clause 2.1 confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining to place further Order Forms is not a breach. The only exclusivity-flavoured restraint (12.4, Vendor not to market a directly competing analytics service) binds Vendor and benefits us, so it is not flagged. No document-wide "exclusive", "sole supplier" or "all requirements" language binding Customer exists; the remaining uses of "exclusive" relate to a non-exclusive licence to Customer, non-exclusive remedies, and exclusive jurisdiction.
